params.body:
`cache: npm` requires a lockfile in the repository root and stops the whole run when it finds none. Vera keeps its node modules in `skill/` (`npm ci --prefix skill`) and has none at the root: the runner stopped there with "Dependencies lock file is not found", before anything was measured or written, and the hand could only report "the run ended as failure".

A cache is a speed-up, not a precondition. A lockfile in the root means caching; a lockfile elsewhere means the run simply proceeds.
params.title: Cachen waar er een lockfile ligt, en anders gewoon draaien
